criteria.E1_economics: under the frozen turnover mechanism (top-k dropout): annualised turnover <= 1.10 x the control's AND the paired block-bootstrap (block 8, 10000 draws, seed 0) one-sided lower bound of the net-Sharpe difference at 10 bp, level 1 - 0.05/2, is > 0
criteria.O1_ordering: paired mean difference in per-date Rank IC (ranker - control) > 0 with one-sided HAC lower bound (Bartlett, 4 lags, z = 1.96) > 0
criteria.O2_consistency: IC difference > 0 in at least 6 of 8 folds AND worst-fold IC >= control's worst-fold IC - 0.005
criteria.O3_stability: consecutive-date rank correlation >= control's - 0.02 AND top-group retention >= control's - 0.02 AND bottom-group retention >= control's - 0.02
criteria.carry_forward: the model used as BASE in EXP-009C is the ORDERING_AND_NET_IMPROVED ranker with the larger IC difference; if none, BASE is the sklearn GradientBoostingRegressor (the frozen point-regression baseline)

classification.ORDERING_AND_NET_IMPROVED: O1 and O2 and O3 and E1
classification.ORDERING_IMPROVED_NOT_ECONOMIC: O1 and O2 and O3 and not E1
